measurement_metric: XProf XLA Ops kernel latency; median of three interleaved round medians, 10 calls per round; fine instruction tracing disabled

bandwidth_sensitivity.interpretation: Sensitivity only; no evidence that actual effective bandwidth is half. Production profile unchanged.

confirmed_model_gaps: Unmapped opcodes use placeholder costs without specialized resource reservations.
Some DMA waits have unknown/partial completion credits and credit underflows.
Implicit MSR/GMR, XLU producer/pop dependencies and VMEM bank contention are incomplete.
attribution_limits: No fine instruction timeline for this measured capture.
Same source SHA and libtpu version; exact producing compiler binary/LLO identity not verified.
2.2 GHz is a profile assumption, not independently measured here.
Instruction counts times latency cannot be summed into wall time because instructions overlap.
Model covers full compiled program; hardware metric is XProf kernel time. No host launch overhead attributed.
